signatures.description: Implement RFC 5280 section <ip-address> name-constraints processing for a multi-level certificate chain: permitted and excluded directory subtrees in DNS, IP, email and URI forms, with the distinction between leading-dot full subtrees and host-only constraints. Permitted subtrees must be intersected down the chain into a constrained-name set, excluded subtrees unioned, and any name not covered by the intersection rejected - including the classic traps where a wildcard SAN escapes a subtree, where CN fallback is used when SAN is present, and where an intermediate CA narrows then a leaf widens. Return a per-certificate verdict with the exact violated constraint.
